hint_ladder.title: Common Diff
hint_ladder.text: Hanapin ang common difference: 5-2=3, 8-5=3, 11-8=3. Pare-parehong 3 ang dagdag.

hint_ladder.title: Arithmetic
hint_ladder.text: Arithmetic sequence ito na may d=3. Bawat term, dagdag ng 3.

hint_ladder.title: Find Missing
hint_ladder.text: Ang missing ay after 11, kaya i-add ang 3: 11+3=14.

hint_ladder.title: Check
hint_ladder.text: Check: 14+3=17, tugma sa huling given. So 14 ang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you added 1 instead of 3, thinking the increments changed.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you added 2, maybe mistaking an alternating pattern; still, the pattern is steady +3.

C.text: Correct. Adding the common difference 3 to 11 gives 14, which perfectly fits the sequence.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you used +4, misreading the common difference as 4 instead of 3.

next_time_rule: Sa arithmetic sequence, hanapin ang common difference (d) sa katabing terms. Then add d para sa missing term. Dito, d=3, 11+3=14.
deconstruct_text:
Sa sari-sari store, napansin mo na ang bentang candy ay ganito: Lunes 2 piraso, Martes 5, Miyerkules 8, Huwebes 11, Biyernes ilan? Kung steady ang increase, arithmetic sequence yan.

Kunin ang common difference: 5-2=3, 8-5=3, 11-8=3. Pare-parehong +3. Kaya sa Biyernes: 11+3=14. Then check: 14+3=17, which matches Saturday’s given.

**Watch-Out Zone: pattern_misread**—gamit maling dagdag na 1,2,4 sa halip na 3.
